homeSections.bridalText: Some dresses are worn once and remembered for a lifetime. Ours are cut, sewn and finished by hand, so the one you walk in feels like it was always yours.
homeSections.mtmText: Every dress in the collection can be made to your body. We guide you through each measurement, one at a time.

mtmSteps.title: Choose your dress
mtmSteps.text: Any dress in the collection can be made to your measurements.

mtmSteps.title: Enter your measurements
mtmSteps.text: A guided form, one measurement per screen, with an illustration for each.

mtmSteps.title: We craft and deliver it
mtmSteps.text: Cut and sewn by hand in Prizren, then shipped to you anywhere in the world.

homeSections.lookbookText: Moments from the atelier and the dresses it makes.
homeSections.atelierText: Every dress begins on the atelier table: the fabric chosen by hand, the pattern cut to your measurements, the embroidery placed stitch by stitch, the fit checked before it leaves Prizren.
homeSections.consultTitle: Not sure about your size? Talk to us.
homeSections.consultText: Send us a message or book a video call. We'll help you choose a size or take your measurements together.
